owner_system: YouTube and the channel/presenter recording the video — outside this repo and outside suengj-com.

surface_decides: on-camera visual pacing and delivery choices
core_decides: script content, verification, and voice fit

constraints.format: a spoken-delivery script, not prose meant to be read
constraints.citation_style: verbal attribution or an on-screen citation card; no inline links
constraints.length_hint: paced to a target runtime, not a word count
constraints.register: conversational spoken register; must not read as an article read aloud (see editorial/profiles/transformation/adapt.json anti-patterns)

publication_boundary: Upload and publish authority belongs to whoever owns the channel; this repo produces the script only.

replaceable.note: Substitutable for other spoken-video platforms with compatible script constraints.
